modulus_source: Bambu Technical Data Sheet V2.0, XY tensile modulus; specimens annealed and dried at 65 C for 8 h
limitations: Floor surfaces constrained; real unilateral contact, flexible housing, friction and load direction are not solved.
Linear isotropic continuum approximates printed material. No toolpath-resolved voids, creep, yielding or fatigue.
0.0273 mm is geometric residual travel, not a measured installed deflection.
0.20 mm radial nub rise is not inward travel. Peak insertion travel remains unverified.
Sharp edges and the prescribed finite nub load patch affect local peak strains; peak strain is a screening flag, not a validated allowable.
recommendation: Keep about 0.9 mm minimum in-plane wall and 1.0 mm minimum backing for now. Prefer a longer, tapered interior flex region and tangent blends at relief-to-floor/wall junctions; preserve full walls and nub envelope. Evaluate a roughly 0.4–0.6 mm blend locally rather than assuming a round cutter makes a smooth junction. Recalculate and reslice before claiming reliability.
